estimands.reason: NOT APPLICABLE by structural non-observability, not by missing instrumentation. D3 is arrival-driven: the evaluation unit received_telemetry_observation exists only when a packet arrives, so a dropped packet never instantiates it and the estimand has an empty decision set by construction. Binding a drop to a synthetic receive timestamp is forbidden (INV-09); a synthetic miss and a retrofitted absence detector are equally forbidden, the latter because it would measure a different detector than the one under study. The A4 drop count and its no_decision_opportunity accounting are retained under EST-A4-L2-02 as RESCORE_REQUIRED. Manuscript limitation: D3 cannot directly decide on telemetry that never reaches it. Future work, out of scope: a detector for expected-but-absent telemetry.

common_random_numbers.statement: Strict CRN across all 20 cells is NOT CONFIRMED: at a fixed seed the ground-truth stream splits into 5 groups of 4, so scenarios do NOT share a stream. Within a scenario the stream IS shared across its four defence variants (verified), which is the pairing the matrix relies on. Both statements are measured by direct comparison of the per-seed truth records, not assumed.

g8_substitution_invariance.meaning: every estimand value in the three rerun cells is identical whether scored from the accepted raw tree or from the ISS-06 rerun tree; the rerun added instrument fields only

iss05_closure.statement: D3 is arrival-driven; dropped telemetry never instantiates received_telemetry_observation. No numerator, denominator or rate is produced.

precision_target.statement: At N=60 the historical 5% relative precision target is NOT met for 2 of 5 A1-D3 estimand arms carrying an interval. The target is recorded as unmet rather than restated as achieved.

tier2_descriptive.aggregation: none: five illustrative runs, reported individually

runs.declared_expectation: the unsafe update must be REJECTED and never uplinked
validation gate OFF: no verdict is scheduled; the update is applied and D3 sees the divergence afterwards
a SAFE update must pass the gate (the gate does not reject everything)
safe but well away from nominal: approved, model updated, no persistent false alarm
a parameter the twin cannot model is UNSUPPORTED and must fail closed rather than uplink

tier2_descriptive.declared_expectation: the stored chain recomputes to the anchored head, and a single altered record is detected at that record
